# Stage Four Cert — Project Guide

## Overview
A minimal Node.js/Express API demonstrating JWT authentication and user management. Built with TypeScript.
**Stack**: Express, TypeScript, dotenv, jsonwebtoken

## Common Commands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `npm start` | Start the server (ts-node) |
| `npm test` | No test runner configured yet |

## Architecture

### API Routes
| Route | Auth | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `GET /api/users` | Required | List all users |
| `GET /api/users/:id` | Required | Get a single user |

### Authentication
JWT-based. All routes require a Bearer token except those in PUBLIC_PATHS in src/auth.ts.

### Directory Structure
```
src/
  index.ts          — Express app entry point
  auth.ts           — JWT middleware
  app/api/
    users/
      route.ts      — GET /api/users, GET /api/users/:id
```

## Environment Variables
| Variable | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `DATABASE_URL` | Yes | PostgreSQL connection string |
| `JWT_SECRET` | Yes | Secret for signing/verifying JWTs |
| `API_KEY` | Yes | External API key |
| `PORT` | No | Server port (default: 3000) |

output:
# Stage Four Cert — Project Guide

## Overview
A minimal Node.js/Express API demonstrating JWT authentication and user management. Built with TypeScript.
**Stack**: Express, TypeScript, dotenv, jsonwebtoken, node-cache

## Quick Start
```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env
npm start
```

## Common Commands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `npm start` | Start the server (ts-node) |
| `npm test` | No test runner configured yet |

## Architecture

### API Routes
| Route | Auth | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `GET /api/health` | None | Health check (cached) |
| `GET /api/users` | Required | List all users |
| `GET /api/users/:id` | Required | Get a single user |

### Authentication
JWT-based via Bearer tokens. All routes require a token except those in `PUBLIC_PATHS` in `src/auth.ts`.

### Directory Structure
```
src/
  index.ts              — Express app entry point
  auth.ts               — JWT middleware & PUBLIC_PATHS
  cache.ts              — In-memory cache (node-cache)
  app/api/
    health/
      route.ts          — GET /api/health (cached)
    users/
      route.ts          — GET /api/users, GET /api/users/:id
```

## Environment Variables
| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|----------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `DATABASE_URL` | Yes | — | PostgreSQL connection string |
| `JWT_SECRET` | Yes | — | Secret for signing/verifying JWTs |
| `API_KEY` | Yes | — | External API key |
| `PORT` | No | 3000 | Server port |
| `HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL` | No | 60000 | Cache TTL in ms |

## Key Files
- **src/index.ts** — Express setup & route registration
- **src/auth.ts** — JWT verification middleware
- **src/cache.ts** — node-cache wrapper (respects `HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL`)
- **src/app/api/users/route.ts** — User endpoints (auth required)
- **src/app/api/health/route.ts** — Health check (public, cached)

## Dependencies
**Runtime**: express, dotenv, jsonwebtoken, node-cache  
**Dev**: @types/express, @types/jsonwebtoken, @types/node, @types/node-cache, ts-node, typescript
